messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square is approximately $\{(0,0), (1,0), (0,1), (1,1), (1/2, 1/2 - \sqrt{5}/10), (1/2, 1/2 + \sqrt{5}/10), (1/2 - \sqrt{5}/10, 1/2), (1/2 + \sqrt{5}/10, 1/2), (1/2 - \sqrt{5}/20, 1/2 - 3\sqrt{5}/20), (1/2 + \sqrt{5}/20, 1/2 + 3\sqrt{5}/20), (1/2 + 3\sqrt{5}/20, 1/2 - \sqrt{5}/20), (1/2 - 3\sqrt{5}/20, 1/2 + \sqrt{5}/20), (1/2, 1/2)\}$, achieving a minimum triangle area of $(5-2\\sqrt{5})/40 \\approx 0.01382$. This construction places four points at the corners, eight points on two concentric rotated squares centered at $(1/2,1/2)$ with radii related to the golden ratio, and one point at the center, with the radii chosen so that the minimum-area triangles are formed by three collinear-or-nearly-collinear points on adjacent rays."}
